verdict: Windows Update Agent (wuauserv) could not provide the service. Typically the service is stopped, disabled, or its data store is locked by another process.
fix: Run: `Stop-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,msiserver -Force; Rename-Item %windir%\SoftwareDistribution SoftwareDistribution.old; Rename-Item %windir%\System32\catroot2 catroot2.old; Start-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,msiserver; wuauclt.exe /resetauthorization /detectnow`. If the service will not start, inspect the System event log for `wuauserv` start errors and verify the service's dependencies (`RpcSs`, `DcomLaunch`) are running.
